findings.claim: The diff edits frontend/src/components/FileDetail/ShellLayout.tsx to wrap the knowledge-edit AddonSlot in TextScrollFileIdContext.Provider, a file the touch points do not list.
findings.impact: Every addon component rendered in the knowledge-edit slot of the full page now sees a file id through the context. Any core MarkdownPreview or TextLines inside that slot records and restores scroll under that id. Nothing in the touch points or invariants covers this path, so a future change to the slot could start recording by accident.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/FileDetail/ShellLayout.tsx:~492-507 (new Provider around AddonSlot); the test stub in FileDetail/__tests__/PlainTextDocument.test.tsx reads the context.

bucket_proposal.reason: No declared invariant is broken. The touch-point list is incomplete: the spec says no addons/* file is edited and that FilePreview passes props through, but it never names this slot wiring.

findings.claim: The diff edits frontend/src/components/TextLines.tsx to call useTextScrollProgress, and TextLines is not a listed touch point (only TextPreview, MarkdownFileViewer and MarkdownPreview are).
findings.impact: TextLines also renders archive text entries (ArchiveTextViewer) and other callers. It records only when a TextScrollFileIdContext is set, which is null by default. I7 (a text entry inside an archive writes nothing) therefore depends on the absence of a Provider above it, not on any check in TextLines itself.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/TextLines.tsx:~91-95 (hook call with useContext(TextScrollFileIdContext)); the default value is null in lib/textScrollProgress.ts.
